body:
FOUND BY THE 2026-08-05 AUDIT (suite-health lens, CONFIRMED with file:line; consolidation lens concurs on the fixture). CONSTRAINT FIRST: most named files are FROZEN rails, so the comment/title repairs need rail-renames pairs (Myk authorizes, two PRs, ASCII-only one-line pairs — the mechanism is rehearsed), and the fixture consolidation binds only FUTURE files.

1. test/migrate/survival.test.ts holds an it.skip with NO ticket id in its title, and no queued ticket owns closing it. The house rule: an honest skip names its ticket. Either author the owed ticket and stamp the title (rail-renames pair), or the skip is closeable now — determine which first.
2. test/gateway/negation-closure.test.ts: a comment claims a reader-level assertion while the assertion is negationsOf — delta level. The both-levels rule says name the gap honestly; the comment instead claims the gap is closed. Re-word via a pair, or add the missing reader-level assertion in a NEW file and leave the comment corrected to point at it.
3. test/surface/rest-lens-gate.test.ts's header describes its sibling as describe.skip; the sibling no longer skips. One stale sentence; one pair.
4. THE FIXTURE: signIn/cookiesOf/valueOf (+SAME_ORIGIN) are re-implemented near-identically across ~15 server test files and both browser-era suites. Frozen files keep their copies forever — that is the freeze working. The deliverable is a shared helper (test/helpers/session-fixture.ts or similar) that all FUTURE rails import, plus a line in CLAUDE.md's P3 notes pointing at it, so the sixteenth copy never happens.

RAILS: the helper gets its own small test proving it signs in against a live door (so it cannot drift silently while every consumer mocks around it).

WHO MERGES: the pairs are Myk's (authorization entries); the helper and its test are ordinary bar.
title: The suite tells three small lies, and re-implements one fixture fifteen times
